name: stop_hand
text: A person steps forward and thrusts their right hand forward in a firm stop gesture. Right palm vertical facing forward, fingers straight up, arm straight in front. Keep the stop gesture after stepping forward.

review.notes_zh: 前冲迈步后右臂伸直、手掌竖起示意停下，根前进约0.70米；首版掌面平放且未迈步，第二版用竖掌朝向和前移全身关键帧重新生成。完整手部确认手指朝上。
